rooms.name: Conference Room (1F)
rooms.note: Classroom layout 50 seats, hollow-square layout 28 seats. Fee is 49,500 yen for 2 hours (overtime 12,100 yen per 30 minutes). LCD video projector 16,500 yen, 120-inch screen 5,500 yen, fiber-optic internet connection 16,500 yen (all tax included). Bookings are accepted from 1 year before the date of use (9:00-18:00).

ops.catering: The Conference Room asks that food and drink not be brought in. Boxed lunches start at 3,850 yen, and coffee or tea during a meeting is 605 yen each (tax included, plus a separate service charge). For banquet room decoration, flowers, sound, lighting, entertainment, music, receptionists and gifts, vendors designated by Josui Kaikan must be used (other vendors require Josui Kaikan's prior approval). Off-site catering is available from 30 people, with reservations up to 10 days in advance.
ops.restaurants: The building has Restaurant Jupiter and Cafe & Pub Mercury on 1F, the Japanese restaurant Kyohantei on 3F, and Hitotsubashi Club (restaurant and bar lounge) on 14F. The banquet rooms offer party plans from 30 people, with 2 hours of free drinks, as standing or seated buffets.
